attributes.name: Life Drain
attributes.powers: For your combat check, discard this card to use your Arcane or Divine skill + 2d4.
attributes.recharge: After playing this card, if you do not have either the Arcane or Divine skill, banish it; otherwise, you may succeed at an Arcane 9 or Divine 11 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it. Then shuffle a random card from your discard pile into your deck.
attributes.source: WOTR-1, HV2-B, ORACLE-1, PFTALES-1, UM-1, WITCH-1
attributes.traits: Magic, Arcane, Divine, Attack, Healing, Elite

corrections.corrected_text: On the spell Life Drain, the first paragraph should be just “For your combat check, discard this card to use your Arcane or Divine skill + 2d4.” The second paragraph should end with “Then shuffle a random card from your discard pile into your deck.”
corrections.issue: When you play Life Drain, when exactly should you shuffle the card from your discard pile into your deck?
